That means the URL is probably built with the same `/confirm-email` path as `userSignUp`, instead of a dedicated `/confirm-new-email` path. The link therefore opens the sign-up confirmation page. That page calls the sign-up confirm endpoint, which never applies the pending new email.

fix.description: In `MailService.confirmNewEmail`, build the URL from `app.frontendDomain + '/confirm-new-email'` instead of `/confirm-email`. Set the `hash` query parameter on it.
